text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait in your hand, gain 1 memory.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait from your trash to the hand.
